4/10/16
Shanghai Municipal Council.
3rd October 1916
（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL COUNCIL POLICE FORCE）
POLICE FORCE,
(DETECTIVE BRANCH.)

Sir,
In consequence of a recent telegram from Peking to the Arsenal asking for the immediate despatch to the North of all small arms and ammunition that could be spared, a large quantity of these are now being packed ready for transport.

The workmen at the Arsenal will be paid to-day in Bank of Ningpo notes.

It is reported that General Yang has received information from one of his detectives that three military officers left Woosung for Hsuchowfu during the last two days.

In view of the destitution among many of the rebels who are waiting the result of the investigation of these cases by the Repatriation Board, a number of officers at the Arsenal headed by Col Tsung Ting Hung 麻丁衡 are forming themselves into a xxxx sort of charitable society named the Lieu Woo Taung Zung Tsi Doo Wei 旅沪党人济渡会 with the object of assisting deserving cases.

At 2 p.m. 2nd inst four men representing the Hunan Rebels called at the office for repatriation near the West Gate and put a few pointed questions to the management. They wanted to know how much the Hunan rebels were going to get and whether the money was to be raised locally, how it was to be divided and when and also whether they would publish the amounts and names in the Press. They were informed that the Board was not in a position to answer the questions at present.

The negotiations for the settlement of the painters strike appear to be at a standstill.

Your obedient servant,

Chief Detective Inspector.

Captain Superintendent of Police.

4/10/16
上海工部局。
1916年10月3日
（印：上海工部局警务处）

警务处，
（侦探科。）

先生：

鉴于北京方面近日向兵工厂发出电报，要求立即将所有可腾出的轻武器及弹药运往北方，目前大量此类物资正在打包，准备运输。

兵工厂的工人今日将以宁波银行钞票支付薪水。

据报，杨将军从其一名侦探处获悉，在过去两天内，有三名军官从吴淞前往徐州府。

鉴于许多叛乱分子在等待遣返委员会调查这些案件的结果期间陷入贫困，兵工厂的一批军官在宗定衡（Tsung Ting Hung）上校的率领下，正自行组建一个名为“旅沪党人济渡会”（Lieu Woo Taung Zung Tsi Doo Wei）的慈善团体，旨在援助值得帮助的案件。

本月2日下午2时，四名代表湖南叛乱分子的人士前往西门附近的遣返办公室，向管理层提出了一些尖锐的问题。他们想知道湖南叛乱分子将获得多少款项，这笔钱是否在当地筹集，如何分配以及何时分配，还询问是否会在报刊上公布金额和姓名。他们被告知，委员会目前无法回答这些问题。

关于解决油漆工罢工的谈判似乎陷入停滞。

您顺从的仆人，

总探长。

警务处总监。
